orders: deterministic permutation seeded by sha256(contract_sha256 + mechanism_rules_sha256)
execution_policy.stability: Every repetition and order must yield the same classification and normalized witness; an Unknown or flaky negative is a survivor.
execution_policy.isolation: Each case uses fresh pure inputs and fresh runtime fakes unless its setup explicitly requires retry, race, reopen or replay.
